substantive_difference: The old Plane355 prescreen saved no candidate, PNG, preset or API pair. It rejected a contemplated direct diagonal-to-width color match as a false metric relation. This proposal keeps the real equal-width pair blue, with the diagonal distinctly red rather than presenting it as another 4 cm width. Red compares the actual requested x span with the turn diagonal, targeting measurement-role substitution and predeclaring E=4sqrt(2). No relation symbol is added and red does not stipulate equal lengths. Old Plane186/394 prescreens offer no frozen failed image to reuse. This is a new geometry-role hypothesis; actual native clarity is a separate pre-call gate.
